squad.heading: Building your squad
items: 11 players start on the pitch under one of the formations: 4-4-2, 4-3-3 or 5-2-3 — the other 4 stay on the bench

lineup.heading: Captain, vice-captain and matchday lineup
items: Captain and vice-captain are picked among the starting 11
The captain's points are doubled if they play at least 1 minute
If the captain doesn't play at all, the vice-captain's points are doubled instead

In normal mode (without entering transfers) you can change captain, vice-captain and swap players between the starting XI and the bench at any time before the deadline — this isn't a transfer and has no limit

transfers.heading: Transfers
items: Up to 3 transfers per round — swapping a squad player for a different one from the full player list
Round deadline is the kickoff of the round's first match; after the deadline, changes for that round are locked
Transfers happen separately from normal mode, via the "Make transfers" button — that screen only lets you swap players, with no captain or lineup controls

scoring.heading: How points are scored
scoring.intro: Points are calculated automatically after every match in the round, based on each player's match stats.

rows.goalGkDef: Goal by a goalkeeper or defender

scoring.captainNote: The captain's total points are doubled (×2). Forwards don't score points for a clean sheet.
scoring.benchNote: Bench players score no points — there's no auto-substitution. If a player is injured or out of the squad, move them to the starting XI manually ahead of time.

pricing.heading: How player prices are calculated
items: Price depends on a player's points, goals and assists this season, plus how many matches they've played
Below 5 matches played this season, part of the price is based on their club's final rank last season — so prices don't collapse to the floor right after a player's first match
Prices are recalculated automatically after each round's stats are synced
Unlike some other fantasy games, price doesn't depend on how many managers own the player — only on on-pitch performance
